descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S05 A manual patient and a scanned patient with the same fields look and act the same (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Manual '+' entry (Add New Patient page) works on its own and produces a patient that behaves exactly like a scanned one. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 3; TFA-92580 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician on the local stack with the two fixture patients

When Hospital: add QA Quill by hand with '+', MRN left blank; scan h-identical.png (QA Rowan, MRN cell blank); open both charts and look at both list cards. Nursing Home: add QA Sumac by hand on the add form; scan n-identical.png (QA Tansy); open both charts and look at both All Residents rows

Then Within each context, the two patients show the same field set in the same way: name, room or unit, age and age/sex format (TC-01), MRN shown the same way (not 'MRN-…' on one and '—' on the other), diagnosis (Hospital), Follow-up, hospital day or visit number, and the same chart tabs

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints, plus the compare key: the hospital day or visit number, the age/sex text and the MRN display on the two cards must be equal. Any difference is a Fail unless Daniela lists it as accepted under Q4 (the MRN fill-in is Q5). 'SNF-' on the scanned resident is an invented MRN (U7)

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (compare the two cards' text in code)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
